descriptionChirho: Proper noun referring to Apollos, an Alexandrian Jewish Christian and eloquent preacher mentioned in Acts and the Pauline epistles. All three clusters are case inflections (nominative, genitive, accusative) of the same personal name with no semantic distinction. Spanish 'Apollṓs/de–Apollṓs/a–Apollṓs,' Hindi 'अपुल्लोस/अपोल्लोस' (with minor transliteration variants), Arabic 'أَبُلّوسُ/لِـأَبُلّوسَ/أَبولّوسَ,' Korean '아볼로/아볼로가/아볼로–의/아보로–를,' Swahili 'Apolo/wa–Apolo.' All target languages consistently transliterate the same proper name across all grammatical cases.
